material_choices.topic: Daily origin, next-day interpretation and availability tolerances
material_choices.recommendation: Propose four separate clocks after each eligible daily close: collection starts +15 min; one missing-close retry starts +40 min; information cutoff freezes at +60 min; issuance completes by +75 min and strictly before next open. Require source/processing proof or abstain; no late-input cutoff shift. Per-source NAV schedule and bounded FX age remain proposed; monthly roll already confirmed FND-DEC-002.
material_choices.why_owner_material: Cutoff/grace/FX freshness change executable timing and leakage; no stale-origin backdate.
material_choices.still_open: Source finality and runtime proof for the clocks, per-source NAV publication schedule and FX freshness tolerance.

material_choices.topic: Target events, thresholds and benchmark mapping
material_choices.recommendation: Keep terminal distributions/up/excess/MDD/MAE/loss separate. Choose risk thresholds by horizon and owner use; approve market/kind total-return benchmark mapping and GBP primary basis.

material_choices.still_open: Unchanged: risk thresholds by horizon, market/kind benchmark mapping and GBP primary basis.

material_choices.recommendation: Approve proposed chronological folds, purging, 24-month final test, block uncertainty, provisional 2% primary-loss hurdle/95% paired interval and 80% coverage ±5 pp only after pilot precision evidence. For the live trial (proposed): score the current rules through a frozen, qualified rules-to-probability mapping (R0-RULEMAP), with the strongest eligible R0 distribution baseline standing in for pinball-scored targets; count a short-horizon week when its origins issued cleanly and take the verdict once they mature; count a 3/6/12-month week when it ran cleanly; check long-horizon calibration on the frozen candidate replayed point-in-time on the latest matured walk-forward origins.
material_choices.why_owner_material: Caps/thresholds are design proposals, not established performance standards; long horizons may remain unavailable.
material_choices.still_open: The 8-week shadow trial, the pause for a week that cannot be scored and long-horizon reliance on walk-forward history are settled. Still open: folds, purging, 24-month final test, block uncertainty, the provisional 2% hurdle, 95% paired interval and 80% coverage tolerance, and whether that hurdle also applies to the trial; how the current rules get a proper score (they give only heuristic strength, so the rules leg of the trial and of a rules-change trial has no score until a mapping qualifies); what a scored week is for each horizon; and how a 3/6/12-month candidate is checked as 'calibrated on what has matured' when nothing it issues in the trial matures.

material_choices.topic: Worse-week scoring rule and exact safety triggers
material_choices.recommendation: A bad week is a strictly worse mean primary proper score (SCI-06) for the live model than the previous approved model on that week's matured paired origins, per task scope; a week with no matured paired forecasts neither counts nor breaks a run; probation reverts after 2 bad weeks running. Exact deterministic safety triggers (invalid hash, revoked rights, corrupt or missing inputs, budget ceiling) are listed for advance approval. Proposed for a first promotion, with no previous approved model: the comparator and revert target are the current rules scored through the SCI-D03 rules mapping, a revert withdraws the model's probabilities, and without a qualified mapping the scope pauses (POLICY-003).
material_choices.why_owner_material: Weekly samples are small and noisy: the rule sets how often a sound model is reverted, and whether 2 probation weeks must run consecutively.
material_choices.still_open: The worse-week metric, pairing and minimum count; whether the 2 probation weeks must run consecutively; the exact safety triggers for advance approval; and the comparator and revert target at a first promotion.

material_choices.topic: Bounded self-correction: band windows, overlay lineage on promotion and revert, and rollback detection by horizon
material_choices.recommendation: Read both bands as cumulative change against the value at the start of a rolling window: at most 5 percentage points on an issued probability in any 7 days, and at most 10% of the start value on a signal's weight in any 30 days. Each artefact keeps its own overlay lineage: a promoted model carries the overlay its shadow run built during the trial, and a reverted-to model resumes its own latest overlay. Keep one overlay step in flight per horizon: a new step waits until the previous one has a predeclared minimum of matured paired forecasts, so 3/6/12-month horizons take at most one step per horizon length.
alternatives: 10% of the current weight at each step: repeated steps compound past 10% a month (two 6% steps give 12.36%)
a calendar month: steps either side of a month boundary can move a weight about 21% within a few days
reset every overlay to no adjustment on promotion and revert: the promoted model then runs code its trial did not test
material_choices.why_owner_material: The readings decide how far live probabilities and weights can drift without the owner, what a promoted model starts with, and how long a long-horizon adjustment runs before a rollback could see it (a year for 12 months).
